business_summary: Nanxing Machinery Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, sale, and service of woodworking machinery in China and internationally. The company offers single- and double-sided edge banders; panel dividing saws and CNC nesting machines; CNC drilling and through-feed drilling machines; packing machines; feeder and stackers, turner equipment, and conveyor tables; and nesting and drilling workstations, and edge banding lines. It also provides onsite professional, 24h online quick response, spare parts supplying, and comprehensive training services; and panel furniture, industrial 4,0, software integration, and mass production solutions. In addition, the company engages in the production of metal structural parts, industrial automatic control systems, general equipment, and special packaging equipment; research and development of mechanical equipment, and computer and information technology; data processing and storage support; Internet data and security services; technical development, consultation, exchange, transfer, and promotion; computer network engineering construction and maintenance; network equipment leasing; and computer software and hardware research, development, sales, and maintenance. Further, it is involved in network, information security, and artificial intelligence application software development; computer information system integration; telecommunications business agency; computer network security technical maintenance; Internet access; design and installation of computer information network engineering; mechanical parts and components processing; and sale of information security equipment. The company was formerly known as Nanxing Furniture Machinery & Equipment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nanxing Machinery Co., Ltd. in June 2016. Nanxing Machinery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
